crates/aspis-prover/Cargo.toml.text:
[package]
name = "aspis-prover"
edition.workspace = true
license.workspace = true
version.workspace = true
description = "Host-only prover for the Aspis native WHIR-style M31 PCS substrate"

[features]
# R-E4 measured regression: retained for audit, never selected by default.
r0-r91-audit = ["aspis-statement/r0-r91-audit"]
# Frozen R-E3 differential and passive field-byte tracing; native only.
r0-e4-reference = ["aspis-statement/r0-e4-reference"]
r0-hoist-reference = ["aspis-statement/r0-hoist-reference"]
r0 = ["aspis-core/r0", "aspis-statement/r0"]
insecure-test-ordering = ["aspis-core/insecure-test-ordering"]
insecure-test-framing = ["aspis-core/insecure-test-framing"]
# PROVISIONAL Aspis v5 masking component (A): the block-form circle mask.
# Default OFF. Gates a new module that is not referenced by any v4 code path.
v5-mask = []
# Diagnostic fixture generation only. This is intentionally not enabled by
# any production crate or aggregate feature: it exposes fixed attempt entropy
# so that an expensive full-profile proof can be reproduced byte-for-byte.
insecure-spend-fixture = []
# Measurement-only honest-prover policy.  It may search beyond the ordinary
# minimum valid final-work nonce until the unchanged V7 first-cap-203 schedule
# lands at or below the explicitly acknowledged inclusive counter-20 policy.
# No verifier, transcript, relation, or proof byte changes are enabled by this
# feature.
v7-final-nonce-cutoff-audit = []

[dependencies]
aspis-core = { path = "../aspis-core" }
aspis-statement = { path = "../aspis-statement" }
getrandom.workspace = true
sha2.workspace = true
serde_json.workspace = true
zeroize.workspace = true

[dev-dependencies]
serde_json.workspace = true
sha2.workspace = true

[[example]]
name = "spend_fixture"
required-features = ["insecure-spend-fixture"]

[[test]]
name = "spend_zero_factor_integration"
required-features = ["insecure-spend-fixture"]

crates/aspis-r1-cost-probe/Cargo.toml.text:
[package]
name = "aspis-r1-cost-probe"
edition.workspace = true
license.workspace = true
version.workspace = true
description = "UNPROVED R1 COST PROBE, isolated P2 experiments"

[features]
# PREREG-PROOF-SIZE-2 (2026-10-19): the adopted R1 proof format is the compact
# binary-multiproof format (fixed length 57,607 bytes), which is defined only
# over private leaf salts; the default build therefore carries them.
default = ["private-leaf-salts"]
detail-phases = []
# Existing exact terminal kernels from the selected V7/R117 bundle.
# This changes arithmetic evaluation only; the isolated R1 protocol is unproved.
optimized-terminal = [
    "aspis-statement/pool-v1-pair-forest-packed-digest-selector-tensor-audit",
    "aspis-statement/pool-v1-pair-forest-binary-copy-weights-audit",
    "aspis-statement/pool-v1-pair-forest-endpoint-selector-cache-audit",
    "aspis-statement/pool-v1-pair-forest-semantic-factor-audit",
    "aspis-statement/pool-v1-pair-forest-pattern-window-audit",
    "aspis-statement/pool-v1-pair-forest-copy-tag-dot-basis-audit",
    "aspis-statement/pool-v1-pair-forest-copy-finish-dot-basis-audit",
    "aspis-statement/pool-v1-pair-forest-packed-range-audit",
    "aspis-statement/pool-v1-pair-forest-active-mask-basis-audit",
]
prover = ["private-leaf-salts", "dep:aspis-prover", "dep:serde_json", "dep:sha2"]
private-leaf-salts = []
# LOG D38.3: the prover-side P_R1 check (extracted C3 checker via the z4 probe
# library) and the capped retry loop; requires private leaf salts.
r1p-check = ["prover", "private-leaf-salts", "dep:aspis-z4b-probe", "dep:getrandom"]
r0-op-count = ["aspis-core/r0-op-count"]
# AUDIT ONLY (PREREG-PROOF-SIZE-2 item 4): the retired eight-way verifier
# (124,343-byte proof) under `verifier::eight_way`, for differential evidence
# against saved eight-way fixtures. It never changes the default entrypoints,
# and it is a compile error together with `prover` or on an SBF target.
audit-eight-way = []
# Internal marker set by program dependencies, including native program tests.
program-build = []

[dependencies]
aspis-core = { path = "../aspis-core", features = ["r0"] }
aspis-statement = { path = "../aspis-statement", features = ["r0", "pool-v1-kernel"] }
aspis-prover = { path = "../aspis-prover", features = ["r0", "insecure-spend-fixture"], optional = true }
serde_json = { workspace = true, optional = true }
sha2 = { workspace = true, optional = true }
aspis-z4b-probe = { path = "../../docs/research/v8-r0-zk-20261009/z4", optional = true }
getrandom = { workspace = true, optional = true }

# Historical S1 tool: reads saved eight-way fixtures with the eight-way
# verifier and the host prover, a combination the adopted tree forbids
# (`audit-eight-way` + `prover`). Kept for the record; not buildable.
[[example]]
name = "proof_size_s1"
required-features = ["prover", "audit-eight-way"]

[[example]]
name = "proof_size_s2"
required-features = ["prover"]

[[example]]
name = "readbudget_count"
required-features = ["prover", "compact-binary"]

[[example]]
name = "semantic_gate"
required-features = ["prover"]

# Eight-way mutation offsets (pre-adoption gate); not buildable on the
# adopted tree for the same reason as proof_size_s1.
[[example]]
name = "native_gate"
required-features = ["prover", "audit-eight-way"]

[[example]]
name = "masked_fixture_gate"
required-features = ["prover"]

[[example]]
name = "authenticated_tx2_gate"
required-features = ["prover"]

[[example]]
name = "secure_attempt_gate"
required-features = ["prover", "private-leaf-salts"]

[[example]]
name = "r1p_retry_gate"
required-features = ["r1p-check"]

[[example]]
name = "r1p_sim_gate"
required-features = ["r1p-check"]
